title: Harbor — shared workspace plan
brief: A fictional shared-workspace app with clear access rules and recoverable editing.
objective: Help a small team organize shared projects and understand who can change them.
success: A failed save never discards a draft.

out: Billing, public publishing and live concurrent editing.

context.detail: The first release serves a small team.
context.source: Example scope, to be confirmed for a real project.

sections.title: Original example plan
sections.content:
# Harbor workspace plan

A fictional example for reviewing a small shared-workspace app.

## A0. Baseline decisions

Members can view shared projects. Owners manage invitations.

## A1. Architecture decisions

A browser calls an API that checks membership before reading or changing data.

## A2. Delivery and recovery

Test access checks and preserve drafts after a failed save.

technologies.rationale: Relational database has one clear responsibility in the workspace. Keep this boundary understandable and verify it with representative scenarios.
technologies.tradeoffs: Each extra boundary adds operational work. Keep the first release small and document recovery before adding complexity.
